title: 第七章 擒住飞贼挂名总旗第八章 探查消息火速出击
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 薛宝钗心中愕然。
面上却正了正色，一脸认真。
“姨娘，环兄弟聪慧，又有胆识，日后在神枢营内，定能有一番作为。姨娘也莫要太过忧心，平日里多督促他便是。”
“哎呦，还是宝姑娘说得在理啊！你一向心思缜密，又是个明事理的，往后我还得多仰仗你呢！”
赵姨娘笑得眼睛眯成了一条缝。
两人又寒暄了几句，赵姨娘连茶都顾不上喝，便抱着绸缎，起身告辞，忙着去向旁人“诉苦”了。
翌日，晨。
一大清早，贾环带上周旭、马癞和霍老三人，走在小花枝巷的街道上。
精神抖擞，四顾而盼，巴不得再跑出一个贼人，能被他们一举拿下！
“霍老三，你不是消息灵通吗？近来可有听着什么贼人的风声？”
“头儿，给我一两日，我得去打听打听。”霍老讪讪一笑。
贾环心里也清楚，自个是尝了系统的甜头，有些急了。
但心急吃不了热豆腐，缉拿罪犯这事，总归是要慢慢来的。
“那你先打听吧，无碍……”
忽而，马癞发现一个人影，越墙而过，登时惊呼出声！
“头、头！你瞧那边，有人翻墙！”
话音未落，贾环双足一蹬，直接从马背上跃起来。
刚才正愁没贼人，这会有人翻墙，甭管你是谁吧，梁上君子岂能有好人！
贾环顿时就兴奋了。
“头，等等我们，小心有诈。”
周旭呼喊着想要跟上，但贾环实在是太快了，一晃眼的功夫便上了屋顶。
而运功追上的贾环，果然见到一人，鬼鬼祟祟，正欲要走。
那人回头一看，只见贾环看着左右摇摆，似乎下一刻就要摔下去，可速度却很快，径直往自己这里追来！
“何人追我！”
“京营拱卫在此！小贼休逃！”
贾环仗着凌波微步的速度，捻指间，距离飞贼仅有十米之近。
飞贼亡魂大冒，一大早怎么也能遇到不要命的主？
手心中攥着一把短刀，蓦地朝贾环飞去。
叵耐贾环的凌波微步，本就左挪右闪，根本对不准，反而又被贾环拉近了一些距离！
“该死！”
飞贼暗骂一声，从没见过这般诡异的步伐。
明明看着就要摔了，怎么还能躲过飞刀，毫不费劲的追上自己？
意识到贾环是个难缠的主，飞贼心下略慌，飞檐走壁，无所不用极其。
岂料！这压箱底的轻功都拿出来了，每每回头去看，那贾环就跟鬼魅似的，越来越近！
越来越近！
content_en:
Xue Baochai was shocked.
But his face straightened up and he looked serious.
"Auntie, Brother Huan is smart and courageous. He will definitely be able to accomplish something in the Shenshu Camp in the future. Auntie, don't worry too much. Just supervise him more on weekdays."
"Oh, Miss Bao is right! You have always been thoughtful and sensible. I will have to rely on you more in the future!"
Aunt Zhao smiled so hard that her eyes narrowed into slits.
The two exchanged some more pleasantries, and Aunt Zhao didn't even bother to drink the tea. She hugged the silk and satin, got up and left, and was busy "complaining" to others.
…
The next day, morning.
Early in the morning, Jia Huan took Zhou Xu, Ma Lei and Huo Lao to walk on the streets of Xiaohuazhi Lane.
They were full of energy and looked around, hoping that another thief would come out and be captured by them in one fell swoop!
"Huo Laosan, aren't you well-informed? Have you heard any rumors about thieves recently?"
"Boss, give me a day or two, I have to go and find out." Mr. Huo smiled sarcastically.
Jia Huan also knew in his heart that he had tasted the benefits of the system and was a little anxious.
But you can't eat hot tofu in a hurry, and you have to take your time in apprehending criminals.
"Then you can ask around first, it's okay..."
Suddenly, Ma Lei spotted a figure crossing the wall, and immediately exclaimed!
"Head, head! Look over there, someone climbed over the wall!"
Before he finished speaking, Jia Huan kicked off his feet and jumped up from the horse.
Just now I was worried that there were no thieves. Now someone will climb over the wall. No matter who you are, how can a gentleman in Liang have a good person!
Jia Huan suddenly became excited.
"Boss, wait for us, be careful of fraud."
Zhou Xu shouted and wanted to follow, but Jia Huan was too fast and was on the roof in a blink of an eye.
As expected, Jia Huan, who caught up with his luck, saw a person sneaking around and about to leave.
The man looked back and saw Jia Huan swaying from side to side, as if he was about to fall down the next moment, but he was very fast, chasing him straight towards him!
"Who is chasing me!"
"The Beijing Guards are here! Stop escaping, little thief!"
Jia Huan relied on the speed of Ling Bo's micro-steps, and with a swipe of his fingers, he was only ten meters away from the snitch.
The dead ghosts of snitches are everywhere. How can we meet the master who is desperate for his life so early in the morning?
Holding a short knife in his hand, he suddenly flew towards Jia Huan.
Jia Huan's Lingbo Microstep was already moving left and right, but it was not accurate at all. Instead, Jia Huan pulled him closer!
"Damn it!"
The snitch cursed secretly. He had never seen such weird steps before.
How could he dodge the flying knives and catch up with him effortlessly when he was clearly about to fall?
Realizing that Jia Huan was a difficult master, Snitch panicked a little and flew over eaves and walls, doing whatever he could to get rid of him.
Unexpectedly! I took out all my Qinggong skills at the bottom of the box, and every time I looked back, Jia Huan was getting closer and closer like a ghost!
Getting closer!
title_en: Chapter 7: Capture the snitch and use the flag Chapter 8: Detect the news and attack quickly
